summary: This is a Form 6-K submission by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A., a foreign private issuer, filed with the SEC for April 2026. It serves as a routine cover notice indicating the registrant files annual reports on Form 20-F. Under event-driven classification, a routine foreign issuer report without substantive event details falls outside all special-situation categories.
